description: 1 x Medla (applicants ref. T1) - Approximately 5.00m:  Thin crown density throughout by approximately 20%.  Reduce crown by up to approximately 80cm-1.00m to shape and balance. General maintenance.1 x Mature Acer (applicants ref. T2) - Approximately 6.00m:  Remove climbing plants. Remove dead wood. Thin crown density by approximately 20%.  Reduce overlong branches by approximately 60cm, back into main crown structure. General maintenance.1 x Large Laurel (applicants ref. T3) - Approximately 7.00m:  This plant is over dominant.  Reduce by approximately 1.50-1.80m.  Thin density by 20%. General maintenance.1 x Holly (applicants ref. T4) - Approximately 6.00m: Reduce crown by approximately 1.20m. Thin crown density by 20%.  General maintenance.1 x Bay (applicants ref. T5) - Growing in hedge line: Approximately 7.00m:  Reduce by approximately 1.40m-1.60m, pruning overlong branches back into main crown line. General maintenance.1 x Robinia Frisia (applicants ref. T6) - Approximately 11.00m: Thin crown density by approximately 20%. Remove major dead wood.  Reduce over extended branches by up to approximately 1.20m back into the main crown structure. General maintenance.
